title: Prescriptions Patient Safety Notice: Dispensing-Error Report Windows by Class
content:
Kestrel accepts a dispensing-error report on Kestrel Prescriptions within a window counted in calendar days after pickup, and the handling class sets that window, how soon a corrected remake is ready, and whether a confirmed error earns the rewards goodwill credit.

| Handling class | Short-count window (calendar days after pickup) | Window for any other dispensing error (calendar days after pickup) | Remake ready within (calendar days after the return) | Goodwill credit on a confirmed error |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | 3 | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | 3 | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | 2 | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | 1 | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | 0 | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | 3 | 14 | 1 | Yes |

- A short-count window of 0 means a short count is accepted only on the pickup date.
- The remake column gives the calendar days after the return within which the corrected remake is ready; 0 means the day of the return.

## Examples (hypothetical dates)

- A short count on a Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription picked up on day 0 falls in the window on day 1 and outside it on day 2.
- A short count on a Schedule II Controlled Prescription falls in the window only on the pickup date.
- A wrong-strength fill of a Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription picked up on day 0 falls in the window through day 14; the corrected remake is ready no later than 1 calendar day after the return.
